parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The random variable $W$ has a Poisson distribution.

State the relationship between $\text{E}(W)$ and $\text{Var}(W)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{B}(n, p)$. Jyothi wishes to use a Poisson distribution as an approximate distribution for $X$.

Use the formulae for $\text{E}(X)$ and $\text{Var}(X)$ to explain why it is necessary for $p$ to be close to 0 for this to be a reasonable approximation.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Given that $Y$ has the distribution $\text{B}(20\,000, 0.000\,07)$, use a Poisson distribution to calculate an estimate of $\text{P}(Y > 2)$.
